title: We Love... Space, Sunday August 14th 2011 with Felix Da Housecat and Funkagenda
description:
Funkagenda reflects on the Sunset Terrace as being the spirit of Space while Felix claims it's in his 'zombie room' the Discoteca. Best gigs ever, turning 40, that sort of thing...

Featuring performances from Felix Da Housecat, Hot Chip DJs, Funkagenda, Ian Blevins and Simian Mobile Disco.

http://www.welove-music.com
author: WeLoveTVofficial
